name: Golf- u. Sporthotel Moarhof
beschreibung:
Boasting a spectacular panoramic setting facing the Kaiser mountains, Sporthotel Moarhof features stylish rooms, a generous spa area, and fine gourmet cuisine. It is a premier retreat for golfers, hikers, and wellness seekers.

The Walchsee golf course, the swimming lake, and the Zahmer Kaiser cable cars are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Golf- u. Sporthotel Moarhof in Walchsee offers premium sports holidays, wellness, and leisure in Kaiserwinkl.
